extension.summary: Browse and play videos from a Silo server
extension.news:
*** V1.1.20 *** * Add support for adding/removing items from Favourites and Watchlist, and marking items watched/unwatched on the server (native Kodi buttons may still appear) * Improve episode metadata * Add a "View parent item" context-menu option where applicable, such as opening a show's root from an episode in Continue Watching * Add directory images where available * Add a Discover section * Add preliminary support for skipping credits * Add multi-server support
*** V1.1.10 *** * Add login by device code
*** V1.1.9 *** * Add detailed information to the version picker
*** V1.1.8 *** * Support removal of direct-play availability by the server while retaining the add-on's direct-play-only setting * Improve support for HDR content
*** V1.1.6 *** * Reduce unnecessary adaptive quality switching * Stop identifying the add-on as a Jellyfin app in the server activity dashboard
*** V1.1.5 *** * Group library contents by letter * Optimise API usage to improve responsiveness * Improve session refresh to reduce unexpected logouts and repeated password prompts
*** V1.1.1 *** * Fix "library not found" playback errors for Home category items * Add an option to use Kodi's cached resume position (disabled by default) * Add Your Stuff: Favourites, Watchlist, Collections and History * Add view-only Watch Party support
*** V1.1.0 *** * Add Home categories such as Continue Watching, Recently Released and Recommended * Add an option to combine similar Home categories across libraries * Show banner artwork instead of a text title in the player
*** V1.0.12 *** * When Kodi requests Resume but the server has no resume position, start at 0.1 seconds * When Kodi has no resume point but the server does, automatically resume from the server position * Use server watched states in Search, matching library views * Add episode counts and season artwork to show libraries and Search * Improve metadata and add episode numbers when a skin does not already display them
*** V1.0.11 *** * Fix playback position when the server no longer has a resume point, returning to the beginning instead of using Kodi's stale resume point
*** V1.0.10 *** * Prevent adaptive quality from rapidly switching up and down; find a suitable quality and prefer direct play * Add a setting to always use direct play from the server * Respect stream-termination requests from the server
*** V1.0.9 *** * Add transcoding support (the author noted this had not been personally tested at the time) * Add adaptive quality switching
*** V1.0.8 *** * Show TV shows in Search * Add a login loading indicator
*** V1.0.7 *** * Add extra metadata, with information intended to be sourced from the server * Sync resume points in both directions: check the server when playback starts and update Kodi if the server position changed since the item was loaded * Add Search * Add configurable settings (an additional login may be required after upgrading from an older version) * Add artwork for libraries
